sources.title: Promptfoo GitHub repo
sources.claim: Promptfoo: ~22k stars, TypeScript/MIT, used by OpenAI and Anthropic, covers prompt/agent/RAG testing plus red teaming.

sources.title: DeepEval GitHub repo
sources.claim: DeepEval: ~16k stars, Python/Apache-2.0 LLM evaluation framework.

sources.title: Inspect AI GitHub repo
sources.claim: Inspect (UK AISI): ~2.2k stars, Python/MIT framework for large language model evaluations.

sources.title: OpenAI Evals GitHub repo
sources.claim: OpenAI Evals: ~18.6k stars, benchmark registry, last push Apr 2026, custom license.

sources.title: Ragas GitHub repo
sources.claim: Ragas: ~14.3k stars, Python/Apache-2.0, RAG-focused eval library, last push Feb 2026.

sources.title: lm-evaluation-harness GitHub repo
sources.claim: EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness: ~13k stars, Python/MIT, few-shot benchmarking.

sources.title: TruLens GitHub repo
sources.claim: TruLens: ~3.4k stars, Python/MIT, RAG Triad evaluation and experiment tracking.

sources.title: UpTrain GitHub repo
sources.claim: UpTrain: ~2.4k stars, Python/Apache-2.0, 20+ preconfigured checks; stalled since Aug 2024.

sources.title: Langfuse GitHub repo
sources.claim: Langfuse: ~29k stars, open-source AI engineering platform with LLM evals and observability.

sources.title: Arize Phoenix GitHub repo (API)
sources.claim: Arize Phoenix: ~10.1k stars, AI observability and evaluation.

sources.title: Promptfoo vs DeepEval vs Ragas comparison
sources.claim: Promptfoo ships 50+ assertions and 40+ red-team categories; comparison across three leading testing tools.

sources.title: DeepEval metrics docs
sources.claim: DeepEval runs metrics such as G-Eval, task completion, answer relevancy, faithfulness, bias, toxicity, summarization, tool-correctness.

sources.title: LLM evaluation tools comparison
sources.claim: DeepEval ships purpose-built metrics; Ragas owns deepest RAG metric set.

sources.title: Inspect AI tasks docs
sources.claim: Inspect AI structures evals around tasks, datasets, solvers and scorers with built-in dataset support.

sources.title: Promptfoo vs DeepEval comparison
sources.claim: Operator consensus: mature teams converge on one CI-gating library + one tracing/annotation platform.

sources.title: Best LLM observability tools comparison
sources.claim: LangSmith is default for LangChain/LangGraph teams; Langfuse leads open-source observability.

sources.title: Langfuse pricing
sources.claim: Langfuse Cloud: free Hobby tier → $29 → $199 → $2,499/mo; no per-seat pricing.

sources.title: ClickHouse acquires Langfuse announcement
sources.claim: ClickHouse raised $400M Series D and acquired Langfuse in January 2026, committing to keep it MIT-licensed.

sources.title: LangSmith pricing
sources.claim: LangSmith: Developer free (5k traces/mo, 14-day retention); paid at $39/seat.

sources.title: Braintrust pricing
sources.claim: Braintrust eliminates per-seat pricing: Starter free, unlimited users, 1M traces; Pro $249/mo flat.

sources.title: Arize Phoenix GitHub
sources.claim: Arize Phoenix: OpenTelemetry/OpenInference-native, source-available (Elastic-2.0), ~10k stars.

sources.title: Top 6 agent observability platforms
sources.claim: W&B Weave is closed-source with a strong eval harness, single @weave.op() decorator.

sources.title: Anthropic acqui-hires Humanloop team
sources.claim: Anthropic acqui-hired Humanloop's three co-founders in August 2025; Humanloop shut down September 2025.

sources.title: Comet Opik product page
sources.claim: Comet Opik is a true open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform, ~20k stars.

sources.title: Braintrust Series A announcement
sources.claim: Braintrust raised $36M Series A led by a16z.

sources.title: CoreWeave acquires Weights & Biases
sources.claim: Weights & Biases acquired by CoreWeave for ~$1.7B, closed May 2025.

sources.title: Promptfoo GitHub Action docs
sources.claim: Promptfoo GitHub Action runs before-vs-after eval comparison on every PR touching a prompt.

sources.title: Promptfoo CI/CD docs
sources.claim: Promptfoo provides CLI/CI-CD integration with declarative configs and cached LLM calls.

sources.title: DeepEval CI/CD docs
sources.claim: DeepEval plugs into pytest via assert_test() which raises when a metric falls below threshold.

sources.title: DeepEval GitHub
sources.claim: DeepEval positioned as pytest for LLM apps: ~16k stars.

sources.title: LangSmith vs Braintrust comparison
sources.claim: Braintrust runs eval suites on every PR via native GitHub Action and blocks changes; LangSmith informs rather than blocks.

sources.title: AI agent evaluation pipeline 2026
sources.claim: Teams define pass bands rather than single thresholds; avoid gating inside the 0.41–0.60 moderate confidence band.

sources.title: Hamel's evals guide
sources.claim: Manual vibe-checking fails at scale; validate judge against human labels using TPR/TNR, not accuracy.

sources.title: G-Eval definitive guide
sources.claim: G-Eval uses CoT-generated evaluation steps plus log-prob-weighted form-filling, reaching Spearman 0.514 on SummEval.

sources.title: Self-preference bias paper
sources.claim: GPT-4 shows ~0.520 self-preference score on Chatbot Arena.

sources.title: LLM-as-judge reliability and bias
sources.claim: Consistency breaks down on format/paraphrase changes; >50% error on bias benchmarks despite ~80% human agreement.

sources.title: LLM evaluators analysis
sources.claim: GPT-4 +10%, Claude-v1 +25% own win-rate; Claude-v1 favored first position 70% of the time; >90% preference for longer answers.

sources.title: Pairwise vs direct scoring paper
sources.claim: Direct scoring by LLMs is misaligned with humans in a way calibration cannot fix; prefer pairwise ranking.

sources.title: Ragas metrics docs
sources.claim: Ragas defines four core RAG metrics: faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision, context recall.

sources.title: LLM evaluation frameworks compared
sources.claim: RAG/agent eval lifecycle pairs Ragas for exploration, DeepEval for CI/CD, and a production monitor for ongoing observability.

sources.title: LLM benchmarks guide
sources.claim: Academic-benchmark era defined by MMLU (57 subjects), BIG-bench, Stanford HELM, EleutherAI harness.

sources.title: OpenAI Evals launch coverage
sources.claim: OpenAI open-sourced Evals alongside GPT-4 in March 2023, dangling GPT-4 access for quality benchmark contributions.

sources.title: Best LLM evaluation tools comparison
sources.claim: 2024–2026 platform layer shifted away from static leaderboards toward domain-specific custom metrics.

sources.title: LLM observability market report
sources.claim: LLM observability/eval platform market: $1.97B in 2025 growing to $2.69B in 2026, 36.3% CAGR.
